WITH country_avg_wins AS (
  SELECT 
    circuits.country,
    AVG(constructorStandings.wins) as avg_wins
  FROM constructorStandings
  JOIN races ON constructorStandings.raceId = races.raceId
  JOIN circuits ON races.circuitId = circuits.circuitId
  GROUP BY circuits.country
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) as overall_avg
  FROM country_avg_wins
),
above_overall AS (
  SELECT 
    caw.country,
    caw.avg_wins
  FROM country_avg_wins caw
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE caw.avg_wins > oa.overall_avg
),
above_avg_group_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) as group_avg
  FROM above_overall
),
final_countries AS (
  SELECT 
    ab.country,
    ab.avg_wins
  FROM above_overall ab
  CROSS JOIN above_avg_group_avg aaga
  WHERE ab.avg_wins > aaga.group_avg
)
SELECT
  AVG(fc.avg_wins) as mean_final_avg_wins,
  AVG(fc.avg_wins - oa.overall_avg) as mean_excess_overall,
  AVG(fc.avg_wins - aaga.group_avg) as mean_excess_group
FROM final_countries fc
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
CROSS JOIN above_avg_group_avg aaga     -- the 5 countries (UAE, India, Korea, Singapore, Japan) with avg wins above the above-average group threshold
